parsed.explanation: Decriminalised same-sex conduct is only a secondary signal. The trans-relevant pattern is state-directed repression: a police register of LGBTIQ people, 2024 documented entrapment to register/extort people, raids with forced HIV testing, arbitrary charges, ill-treatment and sexual abuse by officers. These are organised targeting, high severity, and no effective recourse; SOGI protections are absent, LGBTQ groups anonymous, and political/religious hostility suppresses support. Resident LGR and care gaps are not direct visitor harms, though care hostility matters if injured. No execution, presentation crime, border screening, or birth-sex custody rule is documented, keeping it above severe band. Thin visitor-specific evidence does not offset documented police practice.
